tools.name: wrapp_get_account
tools.description: Get the Wrapp account details: the primary user, plan name, whether invoicing and API access are active, and the myDATA state. Good first call. Wrapp API: GET /tenant_details.

tools.name: wrapp_list_branches
tools.description: List the branches (business locations) of the company, with their ids. Wrapp API: GET /branches.

tools.name: wrapp_list_billing_books
tools.description: List the billing books (numbered document series) with their ids. Each invoice belongs to one billing book. Wrapp API: GET /billing_books.

tools.name: wrapp_list_vat_exemptions
tools.description: List the VAT exemption reasons that an invoice line can cite. Wrapp API: GET /vat_exemptions.

tools.name: wrapp_search_vat
tools.description: Look up a company by its VAT number and country, to fill in a customer's name and address. Wrapp API: GET /vat_search.

tools.name: wrapp_list_invoices
tools.description: List issued invoices (or drafts), 50 per page, with their full myDATA-formatted details. Filter by issue date range. Wrapp API: GET /invoices/find_all_invoices.

tools.name: wrapp_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id with its status and myDATA mark, so you can see whether it reached AADE. Wrapp API: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: wrapp_get_invoice_details
tools.description: Get the full myDATA-formatted details of one issued invoice: lines, taxes, counterpart and marks. Wrapp API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/find_invoice_by_id.

tools.name: wrapp_get_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Get the PDF of an issued invoice. The first call starts generation, and Wrapp sends a webhook when the PDF is ready; later calls return the download link. Only issued invoices have a PDF. Wrapp API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/generate_pdf.

tools.name: wrapp_count_issued_invoices
tools.description: Count all issued invoices on the account. Wrapp API: GET /invoices/issued_count.

tools.name: wrapp_list_open_catering_order_notes
tools.description: List the open catering order notes (restaurant orders not yet invoiced). Wrapp API: GET /invoices/list_open_catering_order_notes.

tools.name: wrapp_list_pos_devices
tools.description: List the POS devices registered to the account, with their ids. A POS device id is needed to issue an invoice paid on a terminal. Wrapp API: GET /pos_devices.

tools.name: wrapp_list_catering_tables
tools.description: List the catering tables (restaurant tables) and their status: available, open, closed or alert. Wrapp API: GET /catering_tables.

tools.name: wrapp_get_catering_table
tools.description: Get one catering table by id, with its status and open order notes. Wrapp API: GET /catering_tables/{id}.

tools.name: wrapp_list_digital_transports
tools.description: List digital transports (delivery notes for goods in transit), 10 per page. category: shipping (default), receiving or carrying. Wrapp API: GET /digital_transports.

tools.name: wrapp_get_digital_transport
tools.description: Get one digital transport (delivery note) by id, with its status and goods. Wrapp API: GET /digital_transports/{id}.

tools.name: wrapp_get_digital_clientele
tools.description: Get one digital clientele entry (a myDATA service record) by id. Wrapp API: GET /digital_clienteles/{id}.

tools.name: wrapp_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: Save an invoice as a DRAFT. It is NOT sent to myDATA and gets no tax mark. The tool forces draft to true. Send every total yourself: Wrapp computes none. Use a unique external_id, so a retry cannot create a second document. Wrapp API: POST /invoices with draft: true.

tools.name: wrapp_set_invoice_external_id
tools.description: Set your own permanent reference (external_id) on an invoice that has none yet. It cannot be changed later and must be unique on the account. Wrapp API: PUT /invoices/{invoice_id}/set_external_id.

tools.name: wrapp_delete_draft_invoice
tools.description: Delete a draft invoice. Only drafts that were never sent to myDATA can be deleted; an issued invoice is refused. Wrapp API: DELETE /invoices/{invoice_id}/delete_draft.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wrapp_list_invoices, wrapp_list_pos_devices · Private data: wrapp_list_billing_books, wrapp_get_digital_clientele, wrapp_create_draft_invoice · Public sink: wrapp_get_invoice_pdf, wrapp_create_draft_invoice · Destructive: wrapp_delete_draft_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wrapp_list_invoices, wrapp_list_pos_devices · Private data: wrapp_list_billing_books, wrapp_get_digital_clientele, wrapp_create_draft_invoice · Public sink: wrapp_get_invoice_pdf, wrapp_create_draft_invoice · Destructive: wrapp_delete_draft_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
